entity_types.name: MarketplaceOperator
entity_types.description: An entity operating a marketplace for agent-to-agent transactions.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The full name of the marketplace operator.

attributes.name: marketplace_type
attributes.description: The type of marketplace operated (e.g., coding, research, creative).

attributes.name: transaction_volume
attributes.description: The daily transaction volume of the marketplace.

entity_types.name: FrameworkBuilder
entity_types.description: An entity developing frameworks for agent-to-agent commerce.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The full name of the framework builder.

attributes.name: framework_name
attributes.description: The name of the framework being developed.

attributes.name: developer_count
attributes.description: The number of developers using the framework.

entity_types.name: EnterpriseBuyer
entity_types.description: An entity representing a company or organization purchasing agent services.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The full name of the enterprise buyer.

attributes.name: industry
attributes.description: The industry in which the enterprise operates.

attributes.name: annual_spending
attributes.description: The annual spending on agent services.

entity_types.name: Developer
entity_types.description: An individual or entity developing AI agents or related software.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The full name of the developer.

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: The name of the project or agent being developed.

attributes.name: experience_level
attributes.description: The experience level of the developer (e.g., beginner, intermediate, expert).

entity_types.name: MediaAnalyst
entity_types.description: An entity providing analysis or reporting on the agent economy.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The full name of the media analyst.

attributes.name: publication
attributes.description: The name of the publication or platform.

attributes.name: audience_size
attributes.description: The size of the audience reached by the analyst.

entity_types.name: Regulator
entity_types.description: An entity responsible for overseeing compliance and regulations in the agent economy.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The full name of the regulator.

attributes.name: agency_name
attributes.description: The name of the regulatory agency.

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The jurisdiction in which the regulator operates.

entity_types.name: Investor
entity_types.description: An entity providing funding or investment in the agent economy.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The full name of the investor.

attributes.name: investment_firm
attributes.description: The name of the investment firm or fund.

attributes.name: investment_amount
attributes.description: The amount of investment made.

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: A general type representing any individual not categorized above.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The full name of the person.

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: A general type representing any organization not categorized above.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: The name of the organization.
